title: Accelerating NLP for Health Equity: Fine-Tuning Binary and Multi-Class Stigma Classifiers in 48 Hours

contributions.purpose: 在既有语料上微调多模型并做可解释性
contributions.mechanism: 微调 DistilBERT/RoBERTa/DeBERTa 等 + SHAP(XAI)解释
contributions.evaluation: 二分类 DeBERTa F1-macro 0.831(95%CI 0.778–0.880),较最强基线 SVM 0.763 +~9 pp
contributions.domain: 临床 NLP / 污名化语言检测
contributions.source_quote: we fine-tune multiple models and apply explainable AI (XAI) methods to enable transparent interpretation of model behavior

contributions.mechanism: 分层交叉验证 + macro-F1 + bootstrap 置信区间
contributions.evaluation: 八分类 DeBERTa F1 0.761(CI 0.729–0.795),浅层 MNB 崩到 0.397
contributions.source_quote: we adopt a rigorous evaluation framework with stratified cross-validation and detailed performance metrics, including macro F1 and bootstrap-based confidence intervals

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现的代理流水线
contributions.mechanism: 发布 48 小时内完成的可复现 notebook,供人类与 AI 代理运行
contributions.evaluation: 48 小时内完成二分类+八分类全流程(anonymous.4open.science 发布)
contributions.source_quote: we release a fully reproducible notebook designed for replication by both human researchers and AI agents.

self_declared_provenance.quote: prior work introduced an expert-annotated corpus of 4,141 text snippets and established strong transformer-based baselines for stigma classification. Building on this foundation, we make three key advances
These contributions go beyond benchmark replication, advancing toward interpretable, trustworthy, and deployable stigma detection systems

notes: 负结果:八分类中 top-2 模型(DeBERTa/RoBERTa)统计检验 no significant difference,浅层基线在少数类崩到近随机(MNB F1 0.397)。数据红旗:Table 2(MHSI 数据集特征)标注 'This summary was completely compiled by GPT-4o'——AI 生成数据描述;结尾自认 agent 需 'careful oversight on factual accuracy'、跨会话 prompt 敏感/不一致限制可复现性。extend 关系明确:基于 Harrigian et al.(2023)4,141 片段语料与其 baseline。
